definitions.explanation: A traffic accident in which only property (vehicles, structures, etc.) is damaged and no person is injured. Contrasted with {人身事故|じんしんじこ} (personal injury accident). Important in insurance and legal contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{幸|さいわ}い→幸い：02774_saiwai⟧{物損事故|ぶっそんじこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}んだ→済む：01950_sumu⟧。
examples.english: Fortunately, it was only a property damage accident.

examples.japanese: {物損事故|ぶっそんじこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}ける→届ける：01248_todokeru⟧べきだ。
examples.english: Even for a property damage accident, you should report it to the police.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駐車場|ちゅうしゃじょう}→駐車場：01667_chuushajou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{物損事故|ぶっそんじこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こした→起こす：01234_okosu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦{相手|あいて}→相手：01677_aite⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{車|くるま}→車：00516_kuruma⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{持|も}ち{主|ぬし}→持ち主：10439_mochinushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見|み}つからなかった→見つかる：01173_mitsukaru⟧。
examples.english: I caused a property damage accident in the parking lot, but I couldn't find the owner of the other car.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal and insurance term frequently encountered in daily life. In Japan, even minor fender benders should be reported to the police for insurance purposes. A {物損事故|ぶっそんじこ} has different legal and insurance implications than a ⟦{人身事故|じんしんじこ}→人身事故：08475_jinshinjiko⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {物損事故|ぶっそんじこ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧ (to cause a property damage accident)
- {物損事故|ぶっそんじこ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧ (to end up as just property damage)
- {物損事故|ぶっそんじこ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{届|とど}け{出|で} (reporting a property damage accident)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{人身事故|じんしんじこ}→人身事故：08475_jinshinjiko⟧: personal injury accident — an accident involving injuries to people
- ⟦{交通事故|こうつうじこ}→交通事故：21255_koutsuujiko⟧: traffic accident — the general term covering all types
